insurer: HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Individual: 1L to 50L (by variant). Family Floater: 2L to 50L (by variant).

great.name: NCB
great.quote: “On Renewal of this Policy with the Company without a break, a sum equal to 10% of the Base Sum Insured of the expiring Policy shall be provided as multiplier benefit irrespective of any claims... The maximum multiplier bonus will not exceed 100% of the Basic Sum Insured in any Policy Year.”
great.explanation: You receive a 10% sum insured bonus on each renewal even if you make claims, up to a maximum of 100%. This means your sum insured can double over time without resetting due to claims.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: “30-day waiting period... Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident”
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered for the first 30 days except accidents. This is the standard waiting period in the industry.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: “Specified disease/procedure waiting period... excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with us.”
good.explanation: Certain diseases and procedures are excluded for 24 months from policy start. This is a typical 2-year waiting for specific conditions.

good.name: PED Waiting
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.”
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months from the first policy start. This 3-year waiting is common and not a red flag.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization
good.quote: “Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses... incurred upto 60 days before the date of admission to the Hospital”
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 60 days before hospital admission are covered if related to the hospitalization. This provides good pre-admission support.

good.name: Post-hospitalization
good.quote: “Post-Hospitalization Medical Expenses... incurred upto 90 days after discharge from Hospitalisation”
good.explanation: Follow-up medical expenses up to 90 days after discharge are covered. This is within the standard range for post-hospital care.

bad.name: Restore Benefit
bad.quote: No clause found in provided wording for restoration/reinstatement/reload of Sum Insured after a claim.
bad.reference: Not mentioned in the provided sections
bad.explanation: The policy does not replenish your sum insured after a claim, so once your limit is used up, further claims in the same year are not covered.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: “Annexure I - List I - Items for which coverage is not available in the policy” (includes) “GLOVES”, “MASK”, “NEBULISATION KIT”, “ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHOKIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC]”
bad.explanation: Common hospital consumables like gloves and masks are excluded, meaning you must pay for these out-of-pocket even during hospitalization.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: “Co-payment means a cost-sharing requirement... the policyholder/insured will bear a specified percentage of the admissible claim amount.”
bad.explanation: Co-pay is mentioned but the policy does not state if or when it applies or the percentage. You need to verify the exact co-pay details in your policy schedule.

unclear.name: Room Rent
unclear.quote: “Room Rent means the amount charged by a hospital towards room and boarding expenses and shall include associated medical expenses.”
unclear.explanation: The policy defines room rent but does not specify allowed room types or limits. Check your policy schedule to know if any room rent caps or restrictions apply.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
